M01X_RADIO_01.speaker: RADIO
M01X_RADIO_01.text: Six forty-seven in Nexus City. Clear skies over the harbor, light traffic on the Spire Loop.

M01X_RADIO_02.speaker: RADIO
M01X_RADIO_02.text: And the Capitol says the stability towers finish their maintenance cycle by noon. Stay with us.

M01X_PHONE_MOM.speaker: MOM
M01X_PHONE_MOM.text: Call me when you're up. Love you.

M01X_PHONE_MARA.speaker: MARA
M01X_PHONE_MARA.text: Morning, neighbor! Coffee in the Sky Lounge later? Eleventh floor. Don't be late.

M01X_PHONE_ALERT.speaker: NEXUS ALERT
M01X_PHONE_ALERT.text: Grid maintenance near the stability towers today. Expect flickers.

CINE_00.speaker: NEWS
CINE_00.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Authorities are investigating unusual atmospheric disturbances reported overnight.

CINE_02.speaker: NEWS
CINE_02.text: We're receiving reports of an unidentified phenomenon above the central district—

CINE_06.speaker: NOVA
CINE_06.text: My designation is NOVA. There isn't time to explain.

CINE_08.speaker: NOVA
CINE_08.text: Your reality is collapsing. You need to move. Now.

CINE_09.speaker: NOVA
CINE_09.text: And whatever you do, don't touch the fractures.

M01X_ALARM_PA.speaker: BUILDING
M01X_ALARM_PA.text: Emergency. Structural event. Elevators offline. Use the emergency stairs.

M01X_ALARM_MARA.speaker: MARA
M01X_ALARM_MARA.text: Is anyone there? I'm stuck in the Sky Lounge on eleven. The doors jammed. Please!

M01X_SHOUT_1.speaker: RESIDENT
M01X_SHOUT_1.text: Get out! Get out of the building!

M01X_SHOUT_2.speaker: RESIDENT
M01X_SHOUT_2.text: Where are the stairs? I can't see anything!

M01X_RESCUE.speaker: MARA
M01X_RESCUE.text: You came back for me. Go, go. I'm right behind you.

M01X_DAZED.speaker: MARA
M01X_DAZED.text: Something's coming out of the smoke. Move!

M01X_SURGE_1.speaker: NOVA
M01X_SURGE_1.text: Your body just answered the Fracture. Armor forming. Weapon system online.

M01X_SURGE_2.speaker: NOVA
M01X_SURGE_2.text: Point it at them and squeeze. Your hands know how.

M01X_ANCHOR_1.speaker: NOVA
M01X_ANCHOR_1.text: Something big is anchoring itself to the tear. Your resonance is spiking.

M01X_ANCHOR_2.speaker: NOVA
M01X_ANCHOR_2.text: Don't hold it back. Let it out.

M01X_CLEAR_2.speaker: MARA
M01X_CLEAR_2.text: What did they do to you? What are you?

M01X_CLEAR_3.speaker: NOVA
M01X_CLEAR_3.text: I don't know yet either. Stay with me. We'll learn the rest as we go.

M01X_NUDGE_SURGE.speaker: NOVA
M01X_NUDGE_SURGE.text: Breathe. Find one in your sights. Squeeze.

M01X_NUDGE_ANCHOR.speaker: NOVA
M01X_NUDGE_ANCHOR.text: Reach for it. The surge in your chest: release it at the anchor.

M01X_WORLD_1.speaker: NOVA
M01X_WORLD_1.text: Every city on this world woke up somewhere new this morning.

M01X_WORLD_2.speaker: NOVA
M01X_WORLD_2.text: Nexus was only the first to notice.

M01X_WORLD_3.speaker: PLAYER
M01X_WORLD_3.text: Then we'd better find out where we are.

M01_001.speaker: NEWS
M01_001.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Overnight, residents reported unusual lights over the harbor.

M01_002.speaker: PLAYER
M01_002.text: Another ordinary morning. That would be nice.

M01_003.speaker: NEWS
M01_003.text: Officials say there is no cause for alarm—

M01_005.speaker: NOVA
M01_005.text: Neural resonance confirmed. Can you hear me?

M01_007.speaker: NOVA
M01_007.text: NOVA. Your building is destabilizing. Leave the apartment now.

M01_009.speaker: NOVA
M01_009.text: A Fracture. Reality is intersecting with something it was never meant to touch.

M01_010.speaker: PLAYER
M01_010.text: There are people trapped in the hall.

M01_011.speaker: NOVA
M01_011.text: Then we help them. Move. I will guide you.

M01_013.speaker: PLAYER
M01_013.text: Get behind me. I think I can move this.

M01_014.speaker: NOVA
M01_014.text: That energy came from you. We will understand it later.

M01_015.speaker: PLAYER
M01_015.text: Later sounds good. Where is the exit?

M02_001.speaker: CIVILIAN
M02_001.text: My daughter is on the other side of that door!

M02_002.speaker: PLAYER
M02_002.text: Stay low. I am getting her out.

M02_003.speaker: NOVA
M02_003.text: Structural failure in twenty seconds. The support beam is shifting.

M02_004.speaker: PLAYER
M02_004.text: I can feel something in my hands.

M02_005.speaker: NOVA
M02_005.text: Focus on the beam. Do not fight the current; redirect it.

M02_008.speaker: CIVILIAN
M02_008.text: Thank you. I thought we were gone.

M02_009.speaker: PLAYER
M02_009.text: Take the service stairs. Do not stop.

M02_010.speaker: NOVA
M02_010.text: You used a Fracture ability without an Operator interface. That should be impossible.

M02_011.speaker: PLAYER
M02_011.text: Then stop telling me what should be possible.

M03_001.speaker: RADIO
M03_001.text: Emergency services are asking residents to shelter indoors.

M03_002.speaker: PLAYER
M03_002.text: That advice is a little late.

M03_003.speaker: NOVA
M03_003.text: Three safe routes. Two are already changing.

M03_005.speaker: NOVA
M03_005.text: The road ahead now connects to a place that did not exist this morning.

M03_006.speaker: SURVIVOR
M03_006.text: Those things came out of the purple light!

M03_007.speaker: PLAYER
M03_007.text: Get to the transit station. I will hold them off.

M03_008.speaker: NOVA
M03_008.text: Remember: cover, movement, then ability. Survive first.

M03_009.speaker: PLAYER
M03_009.text: And if the street tears open again?

M04_002.speaker: PLAYER
M04_002.text: I woke up in an apartment. Is that an affiliation?

M04_003.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_003.text: Not if you can explain how you survived the breach.

M04_005.speaker: PLAYER
M04_005.text: I can hear a voice. It says its name is NOVA.

M04_006.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_006.text: That is not possible. NOVA was decommissioned.

M04_007.speaker: NOVA
M04_007.text: That is an inaccurate description of events.

M04_008.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_008.text: Come with us. We can keep civilians safe.

M04_009.speaker: PLAYER
M04_009.text: I will come. But I decide who I help.

M05_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_001.text: We need people who can withstand the Fractures.

M05_002.speaker: PLAYER
M05_002.text: You need soldiers. I am not one.

M05_003.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_003.text: Then be something better. Make your own choice.

M05_004.speaker: NOVA
M05_004.text: There are benefits to cooperating. There are also risks.

M05_005.speaker: PLAYER
M05_005.text: I am not signing away my life because the sky cracked.

M05_006.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_006.text: Fair. Prove you can protect this district, and we talk again.

M05_cooperate_001.speaker: PLAYER
M05_cooperate_001.text: I will work with your team, but civilians come first.

M05_cooperate_002.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_cooperate_002.text: Agreed. You answer to your conscience before you answer to me.

M05_independent_001.speaker: PLAYER
M05_independent_001.text: I will help, but I am not joining your command.

M05_independent_002.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_independent_002.text: Then prove that independence is not indifference.

M06_001.speaker: NOVA
M06_001.text: Verdant Forest. The vegetation has absorbed Fracture energy.

M06_003.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_003.text: That is how it catches you off guard.

M06_004.speaker: PLAYER
M06_004.text: You have been out here alone?

M06_005.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_005.text: Long enough to learn that the forest remembers footsteps.

M06_007.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_007.text: Do not call every secret a target. Some deserve to stay hidden.

M06_008.speaker: PLAYER
M06_008.text: We will look. We will not destroy what we do not understand.

M07_001.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_001.text: Outsiders keep taking samples. Then they wonder why the trees attack.

M07_002.speaker: PLAYER
M07_002.text: I came for answers, not trophies.

M07_004.speaker: NOVA
M07_004.text: The dungeon architecture is shifting while we speak.

M07_005.speaker: PLAYER
M07_005.text: Then our map is already wrong.

M07_006.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_006.text: Follow the living roots. They do not lie. They simply refuse to explain.

M07_protect_forest_001.speaker: PLAYER
M07_protect_forest_001.text: Seal the extraction site. The forest has already paid enough.

M07_protect_forest_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_protect_forest_002.text: Then you have an ally here.

M07_take_sample_001.speaker: PLAYER
M07_take_sample_001.text: One sample, documented, and no more damage.

M07_take_sample_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_take_sample_002.text: I will hold you to every word.

M08_001.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_001.text: Your ride will survive the dunes. Your driving? Different question.

M08_002.speaker: PLAYER
M08_002.text: How much for a vehicle that does not fall apart?

M08_003.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_003.text: More than you have. Win the convoy run and we can negotiate.

M08_004.speaker: NOVA
M08_004.text: Weather front approaching. Sand density rising.

M08_005.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_005.text: Out here the storm is a rival, not a backdrop.

M09_001.speaker: VYRAK
M09_001.text: WHO DISTURBS THE COVENANT OF ASH?

M09_002.speaker: PLAYER
M09_002.text: Someone who has crossed too much desert to turn around.

M09_004.speaker: NOVA
M09_004.text: Airborne phase. Watch the shadow before the dive.

M09_006.speaker: VYRAK
M09_006.text: MY SCALES BREAK, BUT MY OATH DOES NOT.

M09_007.speaker: NOVA
M09_007.text: Chest weak point exposed. Wait for the next attack cycle.

M09_008.speaker: PLAYER
M09_008.text: I am not here to steal your power.

M09_009.speaker: VYRAK
M09_009.text: THEN SHOW ME WHY YOU DESERVE TO LIVE.

M09_010.speaker: NOVA
M09_010.text: Final strike window. Your choice must be deliberate.

M10_001.speaker: PLAYER
M10_001.text: You were the size of a mountain a minute ago.

M10_002.speaker: VYRAK
M10_002.text: DO NOT CONFUSE FORM WITH STRENGTH, LITTLE OPERATOR.

M10_005.speaker: VYRAK
M10_005.text: TRUST IS EARNED. RIDING IS NOT A PRIZE FOR ONE VICTORY.

M10_006.speaker: PLAYER
M10_006.text: Then we start by learning to work together.

M11_001.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_001.text: In Neon City every camera sees you, and every camera can lie.

M11_002.speaker: PLAYER
M11_002.text: I need the source of the Fracture signal.

M11_003.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_003.text: Then you need a driver, a hacker, and a reason not to trust either.

M11_004.speaker: NOVA
M11_004.text: I can perform the second role.

M11_005.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_005.text: Great. The ghost in your head has opinions.

M11_006.speaker: PLAYER
M11_006.text: Can we focus on the signal?

M11_007.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_007.text: Win tonight’s race. I will open the right doors.

M12_001.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_001.text: Thalassia sits offshore from Verdant Forest, deeper than most maps admit.

M12_002.speaker: PLAYER
M12_002.text: How does a whole city survive down there?

M12_004.speaker: NOVA
M12_004.text: Pressure shielding nominal. Unknown life signatures nearby.

M12_005.speaker: PLAYER
M12_005.text: That is a very large shadow.

M12_006.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_006.text: Do not chase it. The sea is not ours to command.

M13_001.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_001.text: Our records show a Fracture before the one you witnessed.

M13_002.speaker: PLAYER
M13_002.text: Why did nobody tell the surface?

M13_004.speaker: NOVA
M13_004.text: Some records are encrypted with my architecture.

M13_007.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_007.text: You may take the archive or protect the people who keep it.

M13_008.speaker: PLAYER
M13_008.text: I am not choosing blind. Tell me what each costs.

M13_preserve_archive_001.speaker: PLAYER
M13_preserve_archive_001.text: The archive stays here. We make copies with your permission.

M13_preserve_archive_002.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_preserve_archive_002.text: For the first time, someone asked.

M13_extract_archive_001.speaker: PLAYER
M13_extract_archive_001.text: We need the archive to prevent another collapse.

M13_extract_archive_002.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_extract_archive_002.text: Then carry the weight of what you have taken.

M14_001.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_001.text: The storm does not kill you quickly. It convinces you to stop moving.

M14_002.speaker: PLAYER
M14_002.text: What is transmitting from the glacier?

M14_003.speaker: NOVA
M14_003.text: A distress call. It is older than the current Fracture.

M14_004.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_004.text: Then whoever sent it should be dead.

M14_005.speaker: PLAYER
M14_005.text: We are going to find out.

M14_006.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_006.text: That answer is why I agreed to guide you.

M15_001.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
M15_001.text: YOU WALK THROUGH A KINGDOM THAT REFUSED TO DIE.

M15_002.speaker: PLAYER
M15_002.text: I did not come to take your throne.

M15_004.speaker: NOVA
M15_004.text: The crown is amplifying the storm. Disable its anchors.

M15_005.speaker: PLAYER
M15_005.text: Then we free the people trapped here.

M15_006.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
M15_006.text: IF YOU BREAK THE CROWN, REMEMBER THOSE IT HELD.

M16_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_001.text: People are calling you a hero. Others are calling you a threat.

M16_003.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_003.text: They know what your choices did to their streets.

M16_004.speaker: NOVA
M16_004.text: Your reputation is changing how factions respond.

M16_005.speaker: PLAYER
M16_005.text: Good. Let them respond to what I do next.

M16_006.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_006.text: Then make sure your next choice is worth defending.

M17_001.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_001.text: Weapons, vehicles, secrets. Everything has a price.

M17_002.speaker: PLAYER
M17_002.text: And what is the price of trust?

M17_003.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_003.text: Usually the thing you cannot afford to lose.

M17_004.speaker: NOVA
M17_004.text: Three factions have offered conflicting contracts.

M17_005.speaker: PLAYER
M17_005.text: Then we choose who benefits, not just who pays.

M17_006.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_006.text: Careful. That kind of thinking is expensive.

M17_support_civilians_001.speaker: PLAYER
M17_support_civilians_001.text: The contract goes to rebuilding the district.

M17_support_civilians_002.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_support_civilians_002.text: You are turning a profit into a promise.

M17_support_faction_001.speaker: PLAYER
M17_support_faction_001.text: We need allies with resources. Take the contract.

M18_001.speaker: PILOT NERI
M18_001.text: We are crossing between continents. The air routes are unstable.

M18_003.speaker: NOVA
M18_003.text: That is not a storm. It is a dimensional seam.

M18_005.speaker: PLAYER
M18_005.text: Hold course. We need to see where it leads.

M18_006.speaker: NOVA
M18_006.text: Then brace. The sky is about to become unfamiliar.

M19_001.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_001.text: You trespass in a land built from the aftermath of war.

M19_002.speaker: PLAYER
M19_002.text: I came to stop another one.

M19_004.speaker: NOVA
M19_004.text: He is testing whether we understand the cost of intervention.

M19_005.speaker: PLAYER
M19_005.text: Then tell me who gets hurt if I walk away.

M19_006.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_006.text: Now you ask the right question.

M20_001.speaker: NOVA
M20_001.text: Eighteen distinct encounter signatures. None follows the public map.

M20_003.speaker: NOVA
M20_003.text: Perhaps in origin. Not in how you unlock them.

M20_004.speaker: WANDERER
M20_004.text: You cannot force a legend to notice you.

M20_005.speaker: PLAYER
M20_005.text: Then I will earn its attention.

M20_006.speaker: WANDERER
M20_006.text: Some doors open for strength. Others for restraint.

M21_001.speaker: WANDERER
M21_001.text: The world has begun answering your actions.

M21_003.speaker: NOVA
M21_003.text: It is a chain reaction. One choice has changed several distant conditions.

M21_004.speaker: WANDERER
M21_004.text: Legends do not wait politely in marked arenas.

M21_005.speaker: PLAYER
M21_005.text: Then I will pay attention to the world instead of the map.

M21_006.speaker: NOVA
M21_006.text: That may be your strongest ability.

M22_002.speaker: PLAYER
M22_002.text: I know. I was waiting for you to tell me why.

M22_003.speaker: NOVA
M22_003.text: My memory was partitioned to prevent the Fracture from locating us.

M22_005.speaker: NOVA
M22_005.text: You were never the intended host. You were the one who chose to help.

M22_006.speaker: PLAYER
M22_006.text: Then stop deciding what I can handle.

M22_007.speaker: NOVA
M22_007.text: Agreed. No more omissions without your consent.

M23_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M23_001.text: Every alliance you made is being tested.

M23_002.speaker: PLAYER
M23_002.text: They can disagree without becoming enemies.

M23_003.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M23_003.text: Not all disagreements survive the first shot.

M23_004.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M23_004.text: The forest will not forgive another invasion.

M23_005.speaker: PLAYER
M23_005.text: Then we keep the fighting away from civilians.

M23_006.speaker: NOVA
M23_006.text: There is no route without loss. There are routes with fewer lives at risk.

M23_negotiate_001.speaker: PLAYER
M23_negotiate_001.text: I am opening a ceasefire channel. Everybody listens.

M23_negotiate_002.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M23_negotiate_002.text: I can give you ten minutes.

M23_evacuate_001.speaker: PLAYER
M23_evacuate_001.text: Forget the meeting. We move civilians out first.

M24_001.speaker: NOVA
M24_001.text: We have reached the origin point.

M24_002.speaker: PLAYER
M24_002.text: It looks like the world is trying to remember itself.

M24_003.speaker: FRACTURE VOICE
M24_003.text: ALL REALITIES SEEK A SINGLE SHAPE.

M24_004.speaker: PLAYER
M24_004.text: Not if that shape destroys everyone living in them.

M24_006.speaker: NOVA
M24_006.text: You do not have to. You only need to choose which boundaries to protect.

M24_007.speaker: PLAYER
M24_007.text: Then we protect the people first. All of them.

M25_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M25_001.text: The Fractures are quiet. For now.

M25_002.speaker: PLAYER
M25_002.text: Quiet is not the same as healed.

M25_003.speaker: NOVA
M25_003.text: The world is still changing. So are you.

M25_004.speaker: VYRAK
M25_004.text: A COVENANT IS NOT AN ENDING. IT IS A PROMISE.

M25_005.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M25_005.text: The forest is growing around the scars.

M25_006.speaker: PILOT NERI
M25_006.text: And the sea has new horizons.

M25_007.speaker: PLAYER
M25_007.text: Then we keep going. There is still a world worth keeping.

M25_rebuild_001.speaker: PLAYER
M25_rebuild_001.text: We rebuild what was lost, one neighborhood at a time.

M25_rebuild_002.speaker: NOVA
M25_rebuild_002.text: Then our next mission begins at home.

M25_explore_001.speaker: PLAYER
M25_explore_001.text: The boundaries are open. We should learn what is beyond them.

M25_explore_002.speaker: NOVA
M25_explore_002.text: I will chart the first route.

AMB_NEXUS_CITY_001.speaker: PEDESTRIAN
AMB_NEXUS_CITY_001.text: The trains are running again. I never thought I would miss the noise.

AMB_NEXUS_CITY_002.speaker: SHOPKEEPER
AMB_NEXUS_CITY_002.text: Fracture insurance? Nobody even knew that was a thing.

AMB_NEXUS_CITY_003.speaker: NOVA
AMB_NEXUS_CITY_003.text: Traffic density rising. The city is learning to breathe again.

AMB_NEON_CITY_001.speaker: RACER
AMB_NEON_CITY_001.text: You can tune the engine. You cannot tune out fear.

AMB_NEON_CITY_002.speaker: MECHANIC
AMB_NEON_CITY_002.text: I can repair the bodywork. The weird purple scratches are your problem.

AMB_NEON_CITY_003.speaker: FIXER SABLE
AMB_NEON_CITY_003.text: Every shortcut in this city has an owner.

AMB_THALASSIA_001.speaker: DIVER
AMB_THALASSIA_001.text: Keep the pressure seal locked until the chamber is clear.

AMB_THALASSIA_002.speaker: CHILD
AMB_THALASSIA_002.text: Do surface people really see the sky every day?

AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_002.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_002.text: Sand gets into everything, including promises.

AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_003.speaker: VYRAK
AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_003.text: THE DESERT LISTENS TO THOSE WHO WALK LIGHTLY.

AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_001.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_001.text: Do not mark that path. It changes by dawn.

AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_002.text: Leave the seedlings. They are not loot.

AMB_FROSTVEIL_001.speaker: RANGER KEST
AMB_FROSTVEIL_001.text: Check your heat pack before you check your weapon.

AMB_FROSTVEIL_002.speaker: TRAVELER
AMB_FROSTVEIL_002.text: The lights in the ice are beautiful. That worries me.

AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_001.speaker: SOLDIER
AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_001.text: The old battlefields still hum at night.

AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_002.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_002.text: Peace is a discipline, not a holiday.

AMB_AZURE_ISLES_001.speaker: PILOT NERI
AMB_AZURE_ISLES_001.text: Crosswinds from the eastern seam. Hold tight.

AMB_AZURE_ISLES_002.speaker: TRADER
AMB_AZURE_ISLES_002.text: No cargo flies free, not even hope.

AMB_SHATTERED_EXPANSE_002.speaker: NOVA
AMB_SHATTERED_EXPANSE_002.text: Anomalous signature detected. No encounter marker available.

COMBAT_001.speaker: NOVA
COMBAT_001.text: Incoming attack. Move out of the impact zone.

COMBAT_003.speaker: NOVA
COMBAT_003.text: Energy low. Use cover while it recovers.

COMBAT_007.speaker: NOVA
COMBAT_007.text: A roaming boss is nearby. Engagement is optional.

VEHICLES_001.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
VEHICLES_001.text: Performance parts are not magic. Balance the build.

VEHICLES_003.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
VEHICLES_003.text: I can. The bill might hurt more than the crash.

VEHICLES_005.speaker: RACER
VEHICLES_005.text: You brought a street car to a storm run? Bold.

COMPANIONS_001.speaker: VYRAK
COMPANIONS_001.text: I WILL FLY BESIDE YOU. RIDING MUST WAIT UNTIL TRUST IS COMPLETE.
